name: Town Centre near the Churches
description: The compact core of Lalibela sits right beside the UNESCO rock-hewn churches, with the main road, small shops, tour guides and eateries clustered nearby. Staying here puts the famous monolithic churches within a short walk of most guesthouses.
bestFor: Pilgrims and travellers wanting the rock churches within walking distance

name: Ridge-top Lodges above Town
description: Along the higher ground surrounding Lalibela sit several lodges and hotels perched to capture sweeping views of the Lasta mountains and highland scenery. These elevated stays offer quiet, cooler air and dramatic sunrises a short drive from the church complex.
bestFor: Visitors seeking mountain views, quiet lodges and highland scenery

name: Local Market Quarter
tagline: Traditional Saturday market and daily trade
description: The area around Lalibela's open-air market, busiest on the Saturday market day when highland farmers gather to trade grain, livestock and crafts. This everyday-life quarter offers a grounded look at local commerce and inexpensive food a short walk from the centre.
bestFor: Budget travellers wanting local markets, street food and everyday culture
